title: Revisiting the quadratic equation with complex numbers

cues.en: Now that you know about complex numbers and how to work with complex numbers, I'd like to go back to the quadratic equation and revisit that video on the quadratic equation.
cues.zh: 現在知道複數，以及如何操作複數，想回到一元二次方程式，重新看看那段影片。

cues.en: So if you haven't already gone through that video, then I recommend pausing this video and going back to watch that video on the quadratic equation and then coming back here.
cues.zh: 如果還沒看過，建議先暫停，回去看，再回到這裡。

cues.en: So you'll remember that in that video, what we did was create a function that computes the quadratic
cues.zh: 記得，那段建立了一個計算一元二次，

cues.en: equation and gives two output corresponding to the two solutions or the two roots of that second degree polynomial.
cues.zh: 方程式的函數，給出兩個輸出，對應二次多項式的兩個解、兩個根。

cues.en: And then what we did was put that into a matrix where we looped over different ranges of these two coefficients, B and C, and then made an image of that.
cues.zh: 再把它放進矩陣，用迴圈跑過 b、c 兩個係數的不同範圍，製作影像。

cues.en: Now you will remember there was this warning that said casting complex values to real discards the imaginary part.
cues.zh: 記得當時有警告：把複數轉成實數，會捨棄虛部。

cues.en: And so what I want to do now is go back and actually separate these plots for the real part and the imaginary part.
cues.zh: 現在想回頭，真正把實部和虛部分開畫。

cues.en: So, in fact, we're going to generate three plots, one corresponding to the real part of the solutions,
cues.zh: 實際會產生三張圖，一張對應解的實部，

cues.en: one corresponding to the imaginary part of the complex solutions and another one corresponding to what's called the magnitude of a complex number.
cues.zh: 一張對應複數解的虛部，另一張對應所謂複數的大小。

cues.en: So the magnitude of a complex number is the distance between the origin of the complex plane and the coordinate that's represented by that complex number.
cues.zh: 複數的大小，就是複平面原點，到複數所表示座標的距離。

cues.en: OK, so let's see what we can do here.
cues.zh: 看看可以怎麼做。

cues.en: So here is our Matrix M, and what I like to do is just start by viewing the real part of M.
cues.zh: 這是矩陣 m，先看 m 的實部。

cues.en: Now, based on this warning message, I already expect that the real part of M is going to produce a graph that looks exactly like this.
cues.zh: 根據警告，預期 m 的實部會產生和這張完全相同的圖。

cues.en: OK, so it does look exactly like this, but we still get this warning here.
cues.zh: 確實一樣，但還是有警告。

cues.en: So maybe let's just ignore this for the moment and see what the imaginary part of M is.
cues.zh: 暫時忽略，看看 m 的虛部。

cues.en: Hmm.
cues.zh: 嗯。

cues.en: And this is just one solid green block.
cues.zh: 只有一整塊綠色。

cues.en: And you can see that this is all at zero and we still get this warning.
cues.zh: 可以看到，全部是 0，也仍然有警告。

cues.en: Now, what's actually happening here is that this warning is not coming from this line of code.
cues.zh: 實際上，警告不是來自這行。

cues.en: This warning is coming from this line of code.
cues.zh: 而是這行。

cues.en: So the output of the quadratic equation function can be complex, valued.
cues.zh: 一元二次方程式函數的輸出，可能是複數。

cues.en: However, this matrix is not set up to handle complex value numbers.
cues.zh: 但這個矩陣，尚未設定成能處理複數值。

cues.en: And so to change this, we actually need to explicitly tell NUM Pi in this Xeros function that we want to be able for this matrix to represent or to contain complex numbers.
cues.zh: 所以得在 NumPy 的 zeros 函數裡，明確告訴它，希望矩陣能表示、包含複數。

cues.en: So you have to write D Type four data type equals complex.
cues.zh: 寫 dtype，代表資料類型，等於 complex。

cues.en: OK, so now I'm going to run this code again and we will see what happens here, huh.
cues.zh: 再執行，看看結果。

cues.en: So OK, so first of all, that warning message went away, so that was already pretty nice.
cues.zh: 首先，警告消失了，很不錯。

cues.en: And now we get this really interesting looking plot where it looks like there's a lot of values that are zeroes here.
cues.zh: 現在得到很有趣的圖，這裡似乎有很多值是 0。

cues.en: Now, I'm going to come back in a moment and talk about how to interpret this plot.
cues.zh: 稍後回來解讀。

cues.en: But first, what I want to do is generate some additional plots and have them all be next to each other so we can see the three plots all side by side.
cues.zh: 先產生更多圖，把它們並排，讓三張圖可以同時比較。

cues.en: So to do that, I'm going to use subplots.
cues.zh: 所以要用子圖。

cues.en: So let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: I will write plotted subplot.
cues.zh: 寫 plt.subplot。

cues.en: And so the subplot function takes three inputs.
cues.zh: subplot 接受三個輸入。

cues.en: The first two inputs correspond to the geometry in terms of the number of rows and the number of columns.
cues.zh: 前兩個對應版面配置，也就是列數和欄數。

cues.en: So I want this figure to have one row, three columns and then the third input corresponds to the axis
cues.zh: 希望這張 figure 有一列、三欄，第三個輸入對應，

cues.en: that you want to be currently working on.
cues.zh: 目前想操作的座標軸。

cues.en: So that's going to be one for the first axis.
cues.zh: 第一個座標軸用 1。

cues.en: Now, if you're thinking it should be zero because Python starts counting at zero, then yes, I agree.
cues.zh: 如果覺得應該用 0，因為 Python 從 0 開始數，我也同意。

cues.en: It's a little bit confusing.
cues.zh: 有點令人混淆。

cues.en: OK, so let's run this code now and see how this looks.
cues.zh: 執行，看看外觀。

cues.en: So notice that this plot got a bit smaller now that Coolabah doesn't really look good anymore, so we
cues.zh: 注意，圖縮小了一點，色條看起來不太好。

cues.en: don't really even need the Coolabah, except it is useful to remember that in this plot, zero caused.
cues.zh: 其實也不太需要色條，但可以記得，這張圖的 0，

cues.en: So a value of zero corresponds to this yellow color over here.
cues.zh: 對應這裡的黃色。

cues.en: OK, so this shows the imaginary, although in fact I would like to show the real part on the left.
cues.zh: 這顯示虛部，不過其實希望最左邊放實部。

cues.en: Now I'm going to copy and paste this code and now we are going to work on the second image.
cues.zh: 複製貼上這段，再處理第二張影像。

cues.en: So that's going to come here.
cues.zh: 會放在這裡。

cues.en: Remember, this is a one by three geometry, so it's one row and three columns.
cues.zh: 記得，版面是一乘三，也就是一列、三欄。

cues.en: Now, this one is actually going to contain the imaginary part.
cues.zh: 這張才要放虛部。

cues.en: And maybe we should make a more informative label.
cues.zh: 也許標籤應該更清楚。

cues.en: I'll say real part, get rid of this and get rid of all this.
cues.zh: 寫實部，去掉這裡，以及這些。

cues.en: And this is going to be the imaginary part.
cues.zh: 這張是虛部。

cues.en: Uh, oops.
cues.zh: 哎呀。

cues.en: And parentheses.
cues.zh: 還有括號。

cues.en: OK, so here I actually copied and pasted too much, so this plot does show command is really only supposed to be run when you are finished plotting.
cues.zh: 這裡其實貼得太多，plt.show 應該等全部畫完，才執行。

cues.en: OK, so now we see these two plots side by side like this.
cues.zh: 現在看到兩張圖並排。

cues.en: However, the Y axis label from this plot is being drawn on top of the real part.
cues.zh: 但這張的 y 軸標籤，畫到實部圖上面了。

cues.en: And in fact, we don't even need these here.
cues.zh: 其實這裡也不需要。

cues.en: So I'm even going to simplify things a bit by getting rid of this.
cues.zh: 所以簡化一點，把它去掉。

cues.en: And so I'm going to get rid of the labels and I'm going to turn off the axis axis off.
cues.zh: 去掉標籤，再用 axis('off') 關掉座標軸。

cues.en: So notice that completely turns off this axis and then I will say the same thing here.
cues.zh: 可以看到，完全關掉這個座標軸，這裡也一樣。

cues.en: OK, now this looks a little bit more interpretable.
cues.zh: 現在比較容易理解。

cues.en: And then the last thing that I want to plot is the magnitude of the complex number.
cues.zh: 最後要畫複數的大小。

cues.en: Again, that was the distance between the origin and the coordinate indicated by the complex number, and that is called the absolute value.
cues.zh: 也就是原點到複數所指定座標的距離，稱為絕對值。

cues.en: So magnitude.
cues.zh: 所以是大小。

cues.en: OK, here the problem is I'm plotting over the second plot here.
cues.zh: 這裡問題是，疊在第二張圖上了。

cues.en: OK, so now that the plotting is done, I want to take a few moments to interpret what you're looking at here, in particular focusing on the real part and the imaginary part.
cues.zh: 圖畫完了，接著花點時間解讀，尤其看實部和虛部。

cues.en: So you can see that there is this structure here, this kind of like looks a bit like a tongue sticking out where there's zero imaginary part here.
cues.zh: 可以看到這種結構，有點像舌頭伸出來，這裡虛部是 0。

cues.en: So zero imaginary part means that there are real valued solutions.
cues.zh: 虛部為 0，代表解是實數。

cues.en: And when there is an imaginary part, then these are complex, valued solutions.
cues.zh: 有虛部時，則是複數值的解。

cues.en: And so to help us interpret this, actually, I will leave the access on for this first plot here.
cues.zh: 為了幫助理解，第一張圖先保留座標軸。

cues.en: So remember that these are the values for B, the second coefficient and these are the values for C.
cues.zh: 記得，這些是第二個係數 b 的值，這些是 c 的值。

cues.en: So what this plot is telling you is that as B gets larger, either negative or positive, so the further
cues.zh: 圖告訴我們，b 越大，不管正或負，也就是，

cues.en: away B gets from zero, the more you have real valued and not complex valued solutions.
cues.zh: b 離 0 越遠，就越常得到實數解，而非複數解。

cues.en: Now that doesn't only work on its own.
cues.zh: 不過，不能只單獨看這個條件。

cues.en: It's actually interacting with the C parameter.
cues.zh: 它其實和 c 參數互相影響。

cues.en: And in particular, as the C parameter gets smaller, so closer to zero, then you're also seeing more and more real value solutions.
cues.zh: 尤其 c 越小、越接近 0，也會看到越多實數解。

cues.en: Now let's keep that interpretation in mind and look back at the formula.
cues.zh: 記住這個解讀，再回頭看公式。

cues.en: So essentially we get complex value solutions when there's a negative number inside this square root.
cues.zh: 基本上，平方根裡的數字為負，就會得到複數解。

cues.en: And how do you get a negative number inside this square root?
cues.zh: 怎樣讓裡面變成負數？

cues.en: Well, you get a negative number basically when this term is larger than this term.
cues.zh: 當這一項大於這一項，就會是負數。

cues.en: So to get real value solutions, you want either B to be large or A time, C, to be small.
cues.zh: 所以要實數解，就希望 b 大，或 a 乘 c 小。

cues.en: And now here we're fixing A to B one.
cues.zh: 這裡把 a 固定為 1。

cues.en: So let's just ignore A and we can just think about C.
cues.zh: 可以先忽略 a，只想 c。

cues.en: So when C is small and B is large, we get real value solutions, which means no complex numbers, which means no imaginary part.
cues.zh: c 小、b 大時，得到實數解，也就是沒有複數部分、沒有虛部。

cues.en: And that's what this graph is showing you here as B gets large.
cues.zh: 這正是圖中呈現的，當 b 變大，

cues.en: And it doesn't matter if it's large, negative or large positive because B ends up being squared.
cues.zh: 不管是很大的負值或正值，因為最後 b 會平方。

cues.en: So this highlights one of the really powerful ways of using Python or other computer numerical softwares
cues.zh: 這凸顯了 Python，或其他電腦數值處理軟體，用來，

cues.en: for visualizing mathematics, because we can get some really beautiful insights into the nature of these
cues.zh: 視覺化數學的強大之處。我們能深入理解這些，

cues.en: equations, in this case, the quadratic formula by making plots of the results of the formulas and kind of looking at the plots and thinking about the formulas.
cues.zh: 方程式的本質，這裡是一元二次方程式的解公式，透過把公式結果畫出來，再觀察圖形、思考公式。
